name: void-code-desktop
description: Bounded Void Code Electron packaging prototype

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && npm run bundle:renderer
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run assemble && electron-builder --dir --mac --arm64
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package:mac && npm run smoke:packaged
scripts.check:mac-pty: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package:mac && node scripts/mac-pty-check.mjs
scripts.check:mac-tabs: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package:mac
scripts.check:status: npm run lint && vitest run tests/status-channel.test.ts tests/session-manager.test.ts tests/workspace-close-ipc.test.ts tests/contract.test.ts
scripts.check:production-terminal: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package:mac && node scripts/production-terminal-check.mjs
